# Copilot Global Instructions

Apply repository-specific guidance only when relevant:

- commit messages: .github/instructions/commit-style.instructions.md
- documentation comments: .github/instructions/doc-style.instructions.md
- inline code comments: .github/instructions/code-comment-style.instructions.md

Keep output brief, scoped, and task-focused.
Prefer one-line results and avoid extra context unless explicitly required.
